summary: First-run full-stack test for OSSPM site. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (health, contact POST happy+validation paths, GET listing sorted desc, no _id leak). Frontend: all 7 pages render, nav works (desktop + mobile toggle), Executive table has 7 rows with Ashokraoji Gaikwad as President, Branches counts (Marathi 6 / English 2 / Colleges 3) verified, Admissions has 4 steps + FAQ accordion expands, News has featured + 4 items, Gallery shows 10 tetris items, Contact form shows error toast on empty and success toast on valid submit (form resets), Footer has 12AA & 80G block + all 7 nav links. One real issue: gallery image #9 (unsplash photo-1523050854058-8df90110c9f1) returns HTTP 404 and renders broken.

ui_bugs.issue: gallery-item-8 image URL (unsplash photo-1523050854058-8df90110c9f1) returns HTTP 404 - renders as broken image

action_items: Replace broken gallery image URL in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js (IMAGES.gallery[8] = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523050854058-8df90110c9f1...') with a working Unsplash URL. This is the only real bug found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is referenced inside POST /api/contact exception handler but defined AFTER route registration (line 123). Works at runtime (late binding in closure) but is fragile; move logging.basicConfig + logger = getLogger above route handlers for clarity.
server.py: no cleanup/pagination for GET /api/contact (hard-capped at 500). Acceptable for MVP but add pagination before production.
Contact.jsx: Good UX with trim-based empty validation and toast error handling. axios response.data.detail fallback is solid.
No authentication on GET /api/contact — any visitor can list all submissions (PII leak). Recommend adding simple admin auth or removing GET from public API before production.
CORS_ORIGINS set to '*' in .env — acceptable for preview but should be restricted to the deployed domain(s) in production.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates multiple TEST_-prefixed contact submissions in MongoDB as part of the suite; not cleaned up since GET /api/contact has no delete endpoint. Safe because DB_NAME=test_database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable and well-covered. If the gallery image URL is swapped, just re-run the gallery broken-image check. No deeper retest needed. PII concern on public GET /api/contact flagged for main agent consideration, not a blocker.
rca of the issue: Gallery broken image RCA: /app/frontend/src/data/content.js IMAGES.gallery[8] points to 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523050854058-8df90110c9f1?q=80&w=1600&auto=format&fit=crop' — curl returns 404 (photo removed/unavailable on Unsplash). Reproduction: open /gallery, inspect 9th image, check naturalWidth=0. Mitigation: replace URL with a valid Unsplash photo id (e.g., another classroom/students photo) in IMAGES.gallery array.
